about: OSM natural=glacier outlines that are not current glaciers. gone: ignored for trail terrain, ice names and glacier places. remnant: never typed glacier; a trail way wholly inside becomes snowfield under remnant_label. See docs/trail-label-repairs.md.

outlines.name: Swift Glacier
outlines.reason: Mount St. Helens. Lost most of its ice in the 1980 eruption; what is left is debris-covered remnant ice.

outlines.name: Hinman Glacier
outlines.reason: Mount Hinman. In August 2022 Mauri Pelto's team found only stranded patches too thin to flow; a lake fills much of the basin.
